skills.name: video-planning
skills.description: Plan an original video from a brief, supplied footage or researched sources; write a script and timed shot list before production.

skills.name: video-editing
skills.description: Cut and assemble local video clips from an edit decision list using FFmpeg, preserving source files.

skills.name: video-overlays
skills.description: Add animated titles, HUD cards, keywords and synchronized SFX to a completed edit without changing its cuts.

skills.name: video-captions
skills.description: Transcribe dialogue to timestamped SRT, correct it and optionally burn readable subtitles into a video.

skills.name: video-audio
skills.description: Mix dialogue, licensed music and locally synthesized sound effects, then measure the final loudness.

skills.name: video-generation
skills.description: Prepare and produce original AI video shots or speaking presenters with a provider connected to the agent environment.

skills.name: video-quality
skills.description: Inspect rendered video, timing, audio and editable delivery assets before handing over a final file.

skills.name: youtube-packaging
skills.description: Create an accurate YouTube title, description, chapters and thumbnail concept from the finished video.
